create_LabeledVideoPaths_from_csv: create a LabeledVideoPaths object by reading a CSV file with video paths and integer labels
create_LabeledVideoPaths_from_directory: create a LabeledVideoPaths object by parsing a directory structure with class subdirectories and video files
create_LabeledVideoPaths_from_path: create a LabeledVideoPaths object from a file or directory path auto-detecting the source type
access_LabeledVideoPaths_by_index: access a video path and label tuple from a LabeledVideoPaths object by integer index
set_LabeledVideoPaths_path_prefix: set a path prefix on a LabeledVideoPaths object to prepend to all video paths
